title: pystagegate
summary: A Python package from the UK's Office for National Statistics providing automated quality-assurance methods for demographic statistical outputs, including a pipeline for provisional-final migration data checks. Its utils module uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a Metadata object to generate synthetic test data for the pipeline.
evidence: src/pystagegate/utils.py:58 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata, default_distribution="norm")' then .fit and .sample called
needs: Confirm intended downstream use of the synthetic data (testing vs. disclosure control) beyond 'Pure synthetic data for testing'.
